dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body section toward the posterior point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical convex bulge visible on the left lateral margin; the right margin exhibits a more uniform curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal plane, distinct from the dark background.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency of diffuse, darker grey pixel clusters localized on the posterior-right flank and around the anterior blowhole region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the light baseline and darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, parallel linear marks with moderate contrast on the posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Longitudinal shadow-casting feature along the posterior central axis indicative of a raised dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, parallel linear marks located on the posterior dorsal region.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast, circular dark aperture at the anterior apex.
